race.comment: DARK MARTIAN (11) snagged back from the wide gate on debut and failed to get into the contest with a battling seventh over 1400m at the Gold Coast. Visors go on from the better draw and no shock to see him take this out. STEADY ON (6) deep into the prep and will find this much easier. Sent to town with a fading on-pace fifth over 1650m at Doomben. Claim helps and has the speed to overcome the wide gate. Each-way player. CREDIBILITY (2) much better performance when he savaged the line from the wide gate to finish second over 1280m at Muswellbrook. Looking for this trip and will be strong late. MACC (4) five-year-old gelding by Nom Du Jeu out of Rosie The Maid on debut for the Paul Snowden yard. At the most recent trial finished fourth at Tuncurry over 1000m. Blinkers go on and worth thought under race conditions.
